intro: A marketing manager resume measured in pipeline and revenue rather than campaigns run, with channels and budgets made explicit.
tips: Tie campaigns to pipeline, revenue or customer numbers.
Name the budget and team you managed.
Show what you tested and learned, not just what you shipped.

basics.name: Laura Schmidt
basics.label: Marketing Manager, B2B
basics.summary: B2B marketing manager with eight years in SaaS. Built the demand generation programme that grew marketing-sourced pipeline from €2m to €9m a year, with a team of five and a €1.2m budget.

work.name: Cloudbase GmbH
highlights: Grew marketing-sourced pipeline from €2m to €9m a year across paid search, content and events.
Rebuilt the website's conversion paths; demo requests up 60%.
Manage a team of five and a €1.2m annual budget.

work.name: Talentio
highlights: Started the company blog and newsletter; 40,000 subscribers in three years.
Ran the webinar programme that generated a quarter of all leads.
